summary: Registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a routine quarterly cash distribution of $0.87 per share to holders of record as of June 30, 2026, payable on July 15, 2026. No merger, tender, spin-off, activist, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a standard current report for a dividend declaration by a closed-end fund or credit company. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are involved. This filing is not a special situation; it is an ordinary distribution announcement.
